comment: Layer->track registry pipeline (slice 1, vault/specs/2026-07-10-layer-track-registry-design.md). Reproduces today's two lanes: geosphere layers come from the generation family json (family-layers), the layers that have no generation graph yet (today: geosphere.mantle, atmosphere.bulk, atmosphere.coupled) are declared via declared-layers.json beside this file. Both feed track-set, which merges, applies the archive overlay, and stable-sorts by sphereId then layerId.
